study_system.region: Pacific coastal dunes from San Francisco, California to the northern range limit near Dunes City, Oregon
study_system.scientific_role: fresh EOG-specific independent validation candidate for the post-Glanville label-invariant Layer-B predictor

independence_boundary.rule: Published aggregate event counts establish plausible estimability and comparator relevance only. They may not tune EOG worlds, Layer-B features, spatial blocks, models, metrics, or favourable/adverse rules.
independence_boundary.label: fresh EOG-specific validation; not completely outcome-naive ecological-system validation

source.source_freeze_rule: Freeze the exact Zenodo archive bytes, archive manifest, documentation/code, and bounded physical headers before any occupancy or abundance row is parsed.

public_process_basis.node_definition: spatially randomized 5 x 5 m coastal-dune survey plots; inclusion must be based on accessible confirmed dune habitat rather than future species occupancy
public_process_basis.candidate_target: survey-recorded colonization by 2022 among plots recorded vacant in 2019 and eligible under the prospectively frozen habitat/survey rule
public_process_basis.local_process_evidence: the publication reports that colonization increases with local abundance in neighbouring plots and suitable habitat area
public_process_basis.source_closure_limit: the survey covers the northern half of the range rather than every potential external source; forecasts must be explicitly conditional on recorded 2019 sources or include a prospectively defined southern-boundary source world from response-free geometry
public_process_basis.historical_claim: none; no unique dispersal route or ancestry is inferred

event_count_feasibility_gate.basis: 232 colonization events among 1223 risk plots make spatially blocked heldout prediction plausible without lowering the Chiricahua event threshold.

node_geometry_gate.critical_question: Does the archive contain a response-free file with stable plot IDs and complete coordinates for the survey-defined plot universe?
pass_if: exact archive bytes and manifest are reproducibly frozen
plot IDs and coordinates are stored separately from occupancy/abundance outcomes or in a file whose rows are demonstrably response-free
node inclusion is habitat/survey-defined rather than selected by 2022 occupancy
coordinate system and units can be audited
the eligible 2019-to-2022 plot universe can be frozen without reading response values
stop_if: coordinates and response values are inseparable in the same row-bearing object
geometry exists only for occupied/eventual-occupied plots
plot IDs cannot be reconciled without response values
the public archive lacks complete coordinates or deterministic pairwise geometry

response_semantics_gate.positive_candidate: eligible plot recorded vacant in 2019 and occupied in 2022
response_semantics_gate.negative_candidate: eligible plot recorded vacant in 2019 and still recorded vacant in 2022
response_semantics_gate.missing_candidate: inaccessible, not revisited, not confirmed as dune habitat, or otherwise missing; excluded rather than recoded as absence
response_semantics_gate.detection_boundary: the endpoint is recorded plot occupancy/abundance, not a claim of perfect detection or latent biological absence
response_semantics_gate.stop_if: revisited/surveyed status cannot be separated from recorded zero before scoring

allowed_at_gate0_inventory: Zenodo landing metadata and exact archive bytes/checksum
archive member names, sizes, CRC values, and extensions
full README, metadata, R/Rmd, and plain-text documentation/code files
bounded first physical record of CSV/TSV/TXT data members
binary-file inventory without loading RData/RDS, shapefile attributes, spreadsheets, or serialized objects
forbidden_at_gate0_inventory: opening DBF/XLSX rows before their role is prospectively adjudicated
response_firewall.header_reader_contract: one bounded physical CR/LF-delimited record only

structural_gate_if_geometry_passes.scale_rule: unchanged response-blind 0.25/0.50/0.75/0.90 largest-component ladder over frozen plot coordinates
requirements: at least three distinct positive thresholds
structural_gate_if_geometry_passes.no_rescue: Do not add kNN, coast-order pseudo-distances, or arbitrary thresholds after a structural failure.

prospective_validation_shape.holdout_class: spatial rather than temporal, because only one 2019-to-2022 transition exists
prospective_validation_shape.candidate_outer_units: contiguous coastline/latitude blocks frozen response-blind from coordinates
prospective_validation_shape.current_source_policy: all eligible plots recorded occupied in 2019 are forecast-origin sources, including sources located in heldout blocks because their state predates the 2022 outcome
prospective_validation_shape.rule_contraction: within each spatial fold, only training-block 2022 colonization positives may contract frozen Layer-A worlds before heldout scoring

two_layer_architecture_freeze.latent_layer: exact frozen process/structural rule identities retained for compatibility, contraction, robust/contingent interpretation, and finite-universe falsification

external_comparator_classes: published-style colonization logistic model using suitable habitat area and prospectively reproducible local abundance/source pressure
fixed flexible classifier using the same response-free covariates and spatial-block design

pass_if: archive manifest and documentation are reproducibly frozen
response-bearing members remain unopened beyond bounded headers
at least one plausible response-free geometry member is identified for a separate role-specific Gate 0 adjudication
stop_if: archive bytes are unavailable or checksum mismatches
response data are exposed by the inventory workflow
the archive contains no plausible response-free geometry route

post_inventory_sequence: adjudicate the exact role of geometry candidates using documentation/code only
open only a prospectively whitelisted response-free geometry object
freeze the eligible node universe and run unchanged structural Gate 1
freeze spatial blocks, source/boundary worlds, Layer B, and strong comparators
synthetic-smoke the complete once-only runner without response rows
open response once and preserve favourable, null, adverse, universe-falsified, or non-estimable outcome
no_rescue_rule: If archive roles, response-free geometry, structural adequacy, or source semantics fail, close the candidate unmerged and move on without opening occupancy rows.
